skill.name: trader-memory-core
skill.description: Track investment theses from screening through closure, including lifecycle status, position data, review schedules, performance metrics, and structured postmortems.
skill.summary: Maintain validated trading thesis records from initial idea through review, closure, and postmortem.
skill.author: tradermonty

No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, shell execution, reconnaissance, obfuscation, or unsafe path traversal was found in the reviewed files. content.user_title: Track Trading Theses From Idea to Postmortem
content.value_statement: Trading ideas often lose context across tools and conversations. This skill stores validated thesis records, manages lifecycle changes, and produces reviews and postmortems.
actual_capabilities: Ingests supported screener outputs or manual records into validated thesis files.
Tracks forward-only status changes from idea through active, closed, or invalidated states.
Records equity shares or futures contracts, including partial closes and cumulative profit or loss.
Lists theses by ticker, status, type, and scheduled review date.
Generates postmortems and summary statistics, with optional FMP price excursion data.
limitations: Phase one supports single-ticker theses, not pair trades or options.
MAE and MFE calculations require an FMP API key and external network access.
Futures calculations support USD-denominated contracts only.
The skill records decisions but does not place trades, synchronize brokers, or provide financial advice.

use_cases.title: Preserve Screener Decisions
use_cases.description: Convert approved screener candidates into consistent records with source provenance, entry criteria, and review dates.

use_cases.title: Maintain Position History
use_cases.description: Record openings, trims, closures, quantities, prices, and cumulative results for equity or futures positions.

use_cases.title: Review Trading Outcomes
use_cases.description: Generate structured postmortems and aggregate statistics to compare outcomes across thesis types.

prompt_templates.title: Register a Manual Thesis
prompt_templates.prompt: Register this manual AMD thesis from amd.json in state/theses, then show the created thesis identifier and validation result.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a basic thesis from a prepared manual record.

prompt_templates.title: Find Reviews Due
prompt_templates.prompt: List ACTIVE AAPL theses in state/theses and identify records due for review by 2026-10-01.
prompt_templates.scenario: Filter current records and prepare a review queue.

prompt_templates.title: Open a Fractional Position
prompt_templates.prompt: Open thesis <id> at 142.10 on 2026-05-02 with 7.86 shares, then confirm its lifecycle status and remaining quantity.
prompt_templates.scenario: Move an entry-ready thesis into active tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Close and Analyze a Trade
prompt_templates.prompt: Close thesis <id> at 165.00 on 2026-06-01, generate its postmortem, and summarize P&L, MAE, MFE, and lessons.
prompt_templates.scenario: Complete the lifecycle and analyze the outcome.

output_examples.input: Register the approved AAPL dividend candidate from the latest screener report.
output_examples.output: Created a validated IDEA thesis for AAPL, preserved its screener provenance, and returned the new thesis identifier.

output_examples.input: Show active theses due for review on 2026-10-01.
output: AAPL is due because its next review date is 2026-09-28.
MSFT is not due because its next review date is 2026-10-15.

output_examples.input: Close the position and prepare a postmortem.
output_examples.output: Closed the thesis, calculated cumulative profit or loss, saved the journal report, and summarized excursion metrics when price data was available.

best_practices: Use lifecycle commands instead of editing thesis files manually.
Validate source reports and confirm ticker, dates, prices, and quantities before changing state.
Keep the state directory version controlled and review generated postmortems before drawing conclusions.
anti_patterns: Do not use manual file edits to bypass schema validation or transition rules.
Do not attach no-trade sizing reports or unsupported non-USD futures contracts.
Do not treat stored outcomes or summary statistics as investment advice.

faq.question: Which thesis types are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports dividend income, growth momentum, mean reversion, earnings drift, and pivot breakout theses.

faq.question: Can it track fractional shares?
faq.answer: Yes. Equity positions accept finite positive fractional share quantities within the documented sanity limit.

faq.question: Can it track futures positions?
faq.answer: Yes. It tracks whole contracts, direction, multiplier, remaining quantity, and USD-denominated contract details.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Core storage works locally. Optional MAE and MFE calculations contact Financial Modeling Prep using an FMP API key.

faq.question: Where does it store information?
faq.answer: It stores validated YAML thesis files, a JSON index, and markdown postmortems in user-selected local state directories.

faq.question: Does it execute trades?
faq.answer: No. It records thesis and position history but does not connect to brokers or submit orders.
